Join us!
Are you studying accounting or finance, or about to finish your degree, and looking for real, hands-on experience in an international group? We have an exciting opportunity for you!
SwissBorg is a crypto wealth management platform operating through a group of regulated entities across Switzerland, France, Estonia and other jurisdictions. We are looking for a part-time Accounts Payable Intern to join our small accounting team. You will handle the day-to-day supplier invoice process and learn how accounting works in a multi-entity group, with the support and supervision of our accounting team.
This is a hands-on role. Some tasks are routine, but accuracy and consistency are what keep our financial operations running smoothly, and you'll learn a lot along the way.
You will: Processing supplier invoices: checking, coding and submitting them for approval in ApprovalMax and Xero
Preparing supplier payments for review and approval
Reconciling supplier statements and following up on open items
Maintaining supplier master data and keeping AP records well organised
Acting as the point of contact for suppliers and internal teams: following up with colleagues across departments for missing invoices, approvals and supporting documents.
Supporting the accounting team with month-end tasks and ad hoc requests
Identifying opportunities to improve and automate the AP process, including with AI tools
About you: Currently studying, or about to complete, a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field
A good understanding of basic accounting principles (debits and credits, accruals, VAT)
Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must: it is our working language across the group. French is a plus
Good Excel skills; experience with Xero or ApprovalMax is a plus
Curiosity about AI and automation tools: ideas for automating and improving our processes are highly valued
Have an interest in crypto
Strong communication skills: comfortable reaching out to and following up with people across different teams, and building good working relationships with them.
A highly organised, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently in a remote team
Eagerness to learn and to ask questions
We can offer you: Hands-on experience with the accounting cycle in an international, multi-entity group
Guidance and supervision from an experienced accounting team
Fully remote, flexible hours that fit around your studies
Exposure to crypto and regulated financial services
